activity_summary: Kemp came off wet through after a quarter of an hour the yard would not end. You told Phillips, from the door, that a man who cannot keep to eleven set lines keeps time to a hair for two hundred bars. Phillips said he will keep anything he made himself. Kemp said he was first on the paper and first in the slippers. Arthur had been the scold. Sam had stolen the shoes in time. You went home.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Came off wet, claimed the paper and the slippers, and refused Sam the shoes.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the eleven lines and the two hundred bars, and went home.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Said Kemp will keep what he made, and covered the drum.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Reported the scold and the short hem.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Said he stole the shoes in time, and asked to wear them.
